task: Design and verify authenticated IPC between the signed MSIX host and elevated helper
selected_direction: Not selected yet. Compare and prove a Windows IPC protocol; existing Boundary -> consumed Permit -> Gateway -> owner remains the sole authority chain.

triage.observed_gap: SystemInstallEffectAdapter writes a user-writable JSON helper ticket; install-v4.ps1 reads that ticket and ledger, then self-elevates. No mutually authenticated in-memory peer channel exists.

protocol.candidate: one-shot local IPC with OS-validated process identities
open_checks: actual host/helper process identity and creation-instance binding
package identity, publisher and helper integrity verification

blocks.reason: The immutable P1 goal explicitly prohibits MSIX activation, while its acceptance requires a positive test of package identity and the actual elevated host-helper path. A non-packaged mock cannot prove that property.
blocks.required_evidence: A harmless, no-op Windows integration test from the signed packaged host through UAC to the helper, capturing both OS-reported peer identities; no selected-target or registry/shortcut effect. This requires an explicitly authorized test-build/activation scope in a successor goal.

blocks.reason: Fresh-context reviewer pass completed with verdict BLOCKED; findings 1-4 identify unresolved production/authentication and evidence gaps.
ShellExecuteEx process-handle behavior for this exact UAC path, package-publisher verification from the helper, alternate-admin ACL behavior, and process-injection boundary remain unproven.

executed_blocks.result: Candidate one-shot named-pipe design documented as PROPOSED/NOT_CANON/NOT_VERIFIED; no production code changed.

valid_findings: Production still transports the ticket/request through user-writable JSON and command-line arguments.
MSIX host source has no IPC or elevated helper peer-verification implementation.
Package publisher and helper script identity validation are incomplete/unproven.
No adversarial tests or no-op Windows UAC integration evidence exists.
inspector.disputed_finding: Inspector claimed the LOCAL pipe namespace and default DACL statement were inaccurate. Checked against Microsoft Learn: packaged-app IPC explicitly requires LOCAL\ in the named pipe; CreateNamedPipe and Named Pipe Security docs explicitly describe the default ACL as read-accessible to Everyone and anonymous. That finding is not accepted; source links are in HOST_HELPER_IPC_DESIGN_20260930.md.
inspector.review_scope_limit: Review covered proposal and source only; it did not validate runtime behavior or production closure.

next_action: Create a successor immutable goal with explicit authorization for a signed test build/package activation and harmless no-op UAC IPC test. Resolve peer/package/publisher/script identity and process-injection threat checks; address the independent review's valid findings before production integration. Keep installation disabled until then.
p0_task_pipeline_tools: Slash commands /plan and /bago-p0-triage are unavailable in this API harness; phases are being followed manually and sequentially.
closure: BLOCKED; protocol proposal is executed, not selected or verified. Existing P0 remains OPEN.
